integrity: The proof derives the inradius from the exact irredundant facet normals and central symmetry, and derives the circumradius from the exact vertex set and an antipodal diameter witness. Finite checks only corroborate small instances; they are not used as proof for arbitrary dimension.
scientific_limitations: The inradius formula is restricted to perfect graphs because it uses the complete clique-indexed facet description. The formulas are for the canonical twisted-prism realization with the standard Euclidean metric and are not affine invariants. The historical 1977 source was not fully accessible during the literature comparison, leaving a bounded residual risk of an older equivalent metric observation.
title: Clique and stability numbers as exact Euclidean radii of perfect-graph Hansen polytopes
